target_semantics_audit.source_semantics: BTS TranStats airline on-time performance reporting: integer minutes difference between actual gate arrival (ARR_TIME) and scheduled gate arrival (CRS_ARR_TIME)

early_stopping_procedure.step_1: Fit inner preprocessor (scaler/vocabs) strictly on inner_train.
early_stopping_procedure.step_2: Train candidate neural net on inner_train; select best_epoch from inner_val loss.
early_stopping_procedure.step_3: Discard inner model weights completely (do NOT reuse).
early_stopping_procedure.step_4: Fit fresh outer preprocessor on full outer_train.
early_stopping_procedure.step_5: Train fresh model on full outer_train for exactly best_epoch epochs (no validation callback).
early_stopping_procedure.step_6: Transform outer_val; evaluate out-of-fold predictions with zero feedback into training.

non_negotiable_safety_rules: 2024 access is sealed FINAL_HOLDOUT and prohibited before explicit final holdout stage.
2023 is DEVELOPMENT_MODEL_SELECTION and prohibited during development.
Weather features are strictly prohibited in Core Arrival.
DEP_DELAY and actual-operation fields are strictly prohibited from Core Arrival predictors.
No in-sample residual uncertainty estimation; OOF/cross-fitted residuals only.
OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM is treated as service/schedule identity, not tail/aircraft identity.
No random splitting; expanding window only.
